title: Timetable conflict (v1)
description: DRAFT by osovyk for review; owner TBD. One shared conflict shape for solver (solve.completed) and validator-lib (problem+json conflicts[]), ADR 2026-11-04-solver-kafka-mvp §2. The rule vocabulary below is the solver's; validator-lib adds its own codes in a MINOR version. Optional fields locate the conflict; the UI resolves ids to labels (teacher signatures only in the scheduler's cabinet).

rule.description: staff_over_passport: non-teaching staff alone exceed the passport (condition=passport). Zero seats in 1.2 are valid (every class remote); negative limits are invalid_input. class_hours_exceed_slots: a class has more weekly hours than lessons_per_day x school days. teacher_weekly_limit: assigned hours exceed the teacher's weekly limit. teacher_hours_exceed_available_slots: hours exceed lessons_per_day x available days. teacher_unavailable_all_days: the teacher has hours but no available day. row_day_cap: a curriculum row cannot fit the per-day cap on available days. alert_bells: alert bells give no usable lessons (model 1.2). packing: CP-SAT proved infeasibility after the pre-checks passed. invalid_input: the request was rejected as invalid (see error.code).

condition.description: Which capacity condition is violated: seats (model 1.2 only) or passport.

hint.description: true = heuristic suggestion (e.g. the busiest teachers for `packing`), not a proof.
